text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Ines Fujin is<n>trembling with sheer
anticipation. I can<n>tell she's even more excited now
than she was before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two of us have chased her<n>dream right onto
this grand stage, and<n>no doubt she's about to
show me<n>where it goes next.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But standing in the way are Mejiro<n>Ryan and Oguri
Cap—two rivals<n>whose hearts burn with the
determination to live up to their fans'<n>expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Without a moment's hesitation, Ines<n>boldly
declares that she's going to<n>enjoy this race more
than anyone.<n>The Arima Kinen of dreams begins!
